result.markdown: --- title: "[vals.fmt_index()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Format values as index characters. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/great-tables/blob/main/great_tables/_formats_vals.py#L1297-L1352){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python vals.fmt_index( x, case="upper", index_algo="repeat", pattern="{x}", locale=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} With numeric values in a list, we can transform those to index values based on letters. The value `1` maps to `"A"`, `2` to `"B"`, and so on through the alphabet. When values exceed 26, the `index_algo` parameter controls how additional characters are generated. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [x]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [X]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A list of numeric values to be formatted as index characters. [case]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["upper"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The case of the resulting characters. `"upper"` (default) or `"lower"`. [index_algo]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["repeat"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The algorithm for values exceeding the character set size. `"repeat"` (default) repeats characters whereas `"excel"` uses Excel-style column naming. [pattern]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["{x}"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : A formatting pattern; `{x}` is the formatted value placeholder. [locale]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : An optional locale ID. Currently reserved for future use. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A list of formatted values is returned. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#ed66e9dc .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from great_tables import vals vals.fmt_index([1, 2, 3, 26, 27]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['A', 'B', 'C', 'Z', 'AA'] ``` ::: :::
